cards.question: How does an RwLock differ from a mutex?
cards.answer: A mutex only lets you take exclusive access even when a shared reference would have been enough. An RwLock lets you have one exclusive mutable reference or multiple shared read references.

cards.question: What access combinations does an RwLock allow?
cards.answer: One exclusive mutable reference, or multiple shared read references.

cards.question: When is an RwLock optimal?
cards.answer: For data that is read frequently but written to infrequently.
